title: A wider lens on the world starts with understanding the sources
summary: Why original documents and clear attribution belong at the heart of global reporting.
meta_description: Why original documents and clear attribution belong at the heart of global reporting.
author: The Current Editorial Desk
paragraphs: International reporting often draws on official statements, local reporting and documentary evidence. Each source has a perspective, and attribution helps readers evaluate a claim.

This is a sample media literacy explainer, not breaking news. For a real story, an editor should confirm the date and context of primary documents and seek additional reporting where claims are contested.
